notes.note: The supplied focus surface establishes the ordinary chain: the dwellings make the destruction evident to the audience; the adversary makes their deeds attractive; the resulting obstruction turns them from the definite path even though they are described as already possessing insight. The focus morphology resolves all 23 analysis words to QAC references, while the shared lahumu/humu analysis entries remain distinct semantic claims.

The branch inventory confirms that root b-ṣ-r has separate focus-carrier branches for ocular seeing, inner comprehension, clarifying illumination, blood traces, protective gear, stitched edges, and soft bright stone, all attached to the same Form X participle occurrence. The root occurrence alone activates none of these alternatives; a global finding must supply an independent wider trigger and return through the focus form.

The branches for the focus forms tabayyana and zayyana distinguish separation, interposition, visible clarification, and semantic explanation from one another, while zayyana explicitly has an eventive beautifying branch distinct from the resulting quality and the adornment class. The global lane therefore needs an independent wider event or relation to activate any of these registered alternatives; root membership and an ayah's ordinary wording alone are insufficient.

The al-sabil registry distinguishes the ordinary path and goal-reaching method from traveler, endowment, dropping, rain, grain, game-stick, bodily-hair, container-edge, and ocular-disease branches. The focus surface itself supplies a definite singular path governed after ʿan, so the global reading must preserve that syntactic path target while any wider activation must be independently anchored.

The dwelling noun's registry keeps the ordinary place and ruins-evidence reading distinct from motion-stilling, household, inner-security, poverty, knife, ship-stabilizer, special-position, and sustenance branches. The adversarial proper name is separately registered with distance, rope, deviation, rebellious-being, and appearance-based alternatives; its nominative agent role in the focus surface must remain intact when evaluating wider resonances.

The ṣ-d-d registry sharply separates the focus verb's ordinary transitive obstruction from its many unrelated homonymous noun branches, while the ʿ-w-d registry distinguishes proper-name background pressure from counting, preparation, timed return, enduring water, and reciprocal-share senses. The global lane must therefore use the exact wider event and a focus-return path rather than root-name resemblance.

The ʿ-m-l registry distinguishes the ordinary owned plural deeds from self-performed work, employing others, official assignment, wages, reciprocal transactions, laborers, and collocations for hardship, aptitude, spear parts, body parts, roads, and pedestrians. Any global candidate that invokes deeds must therefore land on the focus form's ordinary action carrier before a wider trigger can change its reading.

The ʿ-w-d registry keeps the focus proper name distinct from return and repetition, destination, habit, visit, benefit, feast, elderly-animal, old-road, material-wood, legal, and other restricted naming branches; none of these alternatives is activated by name or root alone. The global lane must use a concrete wider trigger that returns through a focus carrier while preserving the ordinary proper-name reference.

The kāna registry keeps the focus auxiliary on realization, being, and reported state, separate from positional location, undertaking, submission, age-related, and restricted bad-state usages. Several wider HFT records in this batch are unresolved and explicitly cannot establish carriers; any global candidate must therefore return through the registered focus occurrence and retain the ordinary copular chain.

The first candidate inventory separates trusted, anchored global claims from legacy-unbound reader summaries. The anchored set proposes surviving dwelling evidence, the recurring beautification-to-obstruction formula, the named adversarial agent, the definite path target, an inverse insight recurrence, and a Thamud ruin-and-dwelling dossier; the unanchored summaries have no context or branch anchors and remain review items rather than presumptive findings.

The anchored context deltas propose several distinct global mechanisms: discernment tested by conduct in 29:2-4, recruitment onto a rival route with false burden transfer in 29:12-13, dwellings as a travel-and-inspection evidence workflow in 29:19-20 and 29:35, embodied inhibition in 29:45, and literal but nonbinding insight amid correct answers and refusal in 29:47-49 and 29:61-63. Each remains a reader inference layered over exact Arabic and must be tied back through registered focus carriers before acceptance.

The final context deltas add state-dependent salience (29:64-65), misallocated trust despite correctly read security (29:67), and effort answered by guidance and plural paths (29:69). Their focus returns are explicit through insight, obstruction, and path branches, but acceptance still depends on branch and connection audits; the reader-summary status remains attributed inference rather than lexical proof.

The first connection catalog supplies strong, exact parallels for the beautification-to-obstruction formula (27:24, 16:63, 8:48, 47:25, 43:37, 27:4, 13:33, 47:32), plus direct ruin and historical-name evidence (46:25, 51:37, 25:38, 53:51). Medium and weak links broaden the evidence field, while no-value links explicitly block unrelated uses such as divine seeing, celestial adornment, and bodily or material ṣ-d-d senses. Prior labels remain nominations; decisions require focus-carrier and boundary checks.

The second connection catalog reinforces two high-value corridors: surviving dwellings as readable historical evidence (28:58, 20:128, 32:26), and the repeated post-clarity beautification or obstruction pattern (9:37, 47:1, 18:7, 3:14, 4:115, 48:12). It also records strong Ad moral-cause evidence (41:15) and many weak or no-value boundaries that prevent overreading unrelated promise, seeing, travel, or eschatological passages.

Connections-003 adds several medium/strong parallels around explicit evidence, dwelling materiality, and insight: 22:16 and 24:34 frame clear signs as guidance; 15:80/15:82 tie Thamud to rejected messengers and secure carved dwellings; 47:23 offers a severe loss-of-sight counterpart; 47:34 directly joins obstruction from Allah's path with persistent disbelief. Several nominations remain weak or unrelated (e.g. divine omniscience, family provision, fasting boundaries).

Connections-004 completes the strongest global parallels: 41:53 and 7:146 link visible signs to clear perception that still may not yield guidance; 5:91 gives a named shaytan obstruction formula; 7:30 and 7:146 show people seeing yet choosing a false path; 7:74, 7:78, 11:67-68, 15:80-83, 22:45, 26:149, and 26:158 supply direct Thamud/Ad dwelling, ruin, and denial details. 9:34 gives a socialized path-blocking form. Weak/no-value records concern unrelated resurrection, family, or legal contexts.

Connections-005 extends the visible-ruin and perception/action pattern: 27:52, 27:69, 30:9, 35:44, 37:137, 40:21, 40:82, and 47:10 frame travel, آثار, and dwellings as inspectable historical evidence; 41:17 states that Thamud preferred blindness over guidance; 46:24 and 46:26 show Ad misreading a visible cloud and possessing sight/hearing without benefit; 7:146 similarly distinguishes seeing the right path from taking it. 89:9 and 91:11/14 give direct Thamud construction, transgression, and destruction context. Derived reciprocal seeds 2:68, 2:208, 2:211, 2:212 were read and treated as nominations requiring fresh assessment.

Connections-006 completes the formula audit. 2:256, 4:167, 5:77, 7:16, 7:175, 7:202 and related 4:119/6:112/6:113 passages establish the perception–choice–obstruction chain, including Satanic beautification, social reinforcement, and path diversion. 4:55 supplies a direct ṣ-d-d parallel. 8:52 recalls moral causation for destruction. Derived reciprocal seeds and one counterevidence seed were read as fresh nominations; weak or no-value items were bounded away from the focus.

Connections-007 adds direct historical and agency support: 12:109 and 14:45 explicitly pair travel, former dwellings, and insight; 14:30 and 15:39/42 connect false objects, Satanic beautification, and path diversion; 17:36 and 20:125 distinguish sensory capacity from accountable understanding; 17:64, 18:50, 19:83, and 22:4 describe Satanic inducement and following. 11:15 supplies a worldly-attraction contrast, and 17:26 is reciprocal counterevidence with no focus value. Strong no-value/weak items were bounded by their exact contexts.

Connections-008 adds further direct agency and historical support: 25:29 and 35:6/36:60/36:62 frame Satanic diversion and human discernment, while 28:87 supplies a direct ṣ-d-d path obstruction and 41:25 joins companion-driven beautification with earlier ruined communities. 26:128, 27:45/51, 35:26, and 38:12-13 extend the Ad/Thamud construction, destruction, and dwelling dossier; 43:36 gives a related Satanic-companion mechanism. Several reciprocal seeds point only to broad destruction or unrelated contexts, and 41:12 is explicitly celestial adornment, so those records remain bounded away from the focus.

Connections-009 closes the broad catalog with direct ṣ-d-d and agency parallels (43:62; 59:16), repeated Ad/Thamud naming and destruction evidence (46:21, 50:12-13, 51:41-44, 53:50, 54:18/23/31/51, 69:7, 85:18, 89:7-13), and a particularly useful dwelling-and-failed-security lesson in 59:2 that calls for reflection by those with sight. 58:19 and 43:36 support Satanic dominance or companionship, while 50:27 and 74:49 frame accountability and turning away. Records centered on divine knowledge, bodily sight, generic punishment, or unrelated prophetic material remain weak or bounded away from the focus.

The final connection page adds only a weak Thamud action seed (91:12) and generic whispering references (114:4/6); these are confirmatory or redundant without the focus's dwelling, beautification, and path chain. They are retained as bounded nominations and do not alter the stronger global corridors already identified.
